column1: Preheat the oven to 350°F (175°C) and grease a 9x13-inch pan.
Microwave the chocolate and butter at half power in 30-second bursts until melted and smooth; let cool slightly.
In a large bowl, mix both sugars with the eggs and vanilla, then stir in the chocolate mixture.
Add the flour and salt and mix just until combined.
Spread about half of the brownie batter evenly in the pan.
Beat the cream cheese, dulce de leche and egg with a mixer on medium until smooth.
Spread the filling over the batter, leaving a small border around the edges.
Dollop the remaining batter on top and swirl with a thin knife or gently spread to cover.
Bake 35–40 minutes until a toothpick in the center shows moist crumbs.
Cool completely in the pan before cutting.
